summary: Built two-lever block mechanism. Lever 1 (explicit block): setBlocked/clearBlocked/isBlocked helpers in lib/overlay.js; blocked map persisted in LOCAL_FIELDS; POST /overlay/block and /overlay/unblock endpoints in routes/overlay.js; block_task and unblock_task MCP tools in lib/mcp-core.js; enforcement in decideOne (daemon.js) excludes blocked tasks from ready pool (sticky, survives graph rebuilds); blocked field surfaced on buildGraph task nodes and /task/detail. Lever 2 (cost_gate): when ov.config.cost_gate is true, any ready task with a metric spec files a blocking guidance item (idempotent) and is auto-blocked; approving via /guidance/resolve decision:approve calls clearBlocked; cost_gate toggle added to /config endpoint. 37/37 new tests pass; label-pressure (24/24) and judge-pressure (11/11) regressions pass. Daemon restart required to activate.

subject: Build expensive-task block mechanism (explicit block + auto-gate)
description: Add a way to stop the autonomous loop from auto-dispatching tasks the user wants gated. TWO levers: (1) explicit per-task block — a sticky overlay flag blocked[task_key]={reason,at} set via new MCP tools block_task/unblock_task; the loop's dispatch path (decideAction/next_action spawn selection) skips blocked tasks entirely; sticky = only explicit unblock clears it, NOT auto-cleared by dep re-derivation (distinct from not_ready). (2) expensive auto-gate — a task flag cost:"high" (or metric/bench tasks) routes through the EXISTING guidance gate (request_guidance, held for user approval) instead of auto-spawning. Motivated by #29 (3-arm bench) being auto-run by the 2hr auto-accept. Needs daemon restart to activate.
